videos.title: You're Never Too Old
videos.description:
A little Rewind Reel for anyone who’s ever wondered, “Am I too old to change careers?” ⏪✨

I’ve gotten this question so many times, and my answer is simple: it’s never too late to change direction.

Your age doesn’t disqualify you from starting something new. In fact, everything you’ve learned along the way comes with you.

If you’ve been thinking about making a change, let this be your reminder: you’re not behind. You’re right on time. 💫

videos.title: What Barbara Corcoran Did After Hearing NO.
videos.description:
Imagine getting rejected from Shark Tank…before you even make it on the show. 😳

That's what happened to Barbara Corcoran. And what she did next? SO GOOD.

I love this story because it's a powerful reminder of how much rejection is part of the game when you're going after something big.

You're gonna hear NO. Sometimes a LOT.
The question is, what are you gonna do about it?

If you've been letting someone else's opinion stop you from going after what you want, take a page from Barbara's playbook

videos.title: Never Let Anyone Take Your Shine
videos.description:
Rewinding to this conversation with Anastasia Soare, founder of Anastasia Beverly Hills. 💄

And WOW, did this part stick with me.

For years, Anastasia wished her straight hair were curly. Her hazel eyes were blue. She spent precious time wishing she could be someone else.

Sound familiar?

Then she learned to stop dimming herself and start owning exactly who she is.

Her words say it all:
“I never let anyone take my shine away, never ever. And you are unique, beautiful, and powerful.”

YES. 👏 B

videos.title: Giving Up Might Be the Answer
videos.description:
Rewinding to my conversation with Simon Sinek. ✨

What if giving up was actually the thing that helped you find your way forward?

In my conversation with Simon Sinek, he shared a powerful story about the moment he stopped fighting so hard for a particular outcome—and what happened when he finally surrendered.

Sometimes, letting go doesn’t mean you’re giving up on your life or your dreams.

Sometimes, it means making space for what comes next. ✨

videos.title: Your Morning Routine Might Be Sabotaging You.
videos.description:
Your morning routine might be sabotaging your productivity before your day even starts. 📱🧠

The second you open your phone, you’re letting other people’s priorities, notifications, and noise into your brain before you’ve had a chance to focus on your own.

Try this instead: give yourself a little time in the morning before you reach for your phone.

Protect your attention. Protect your energy. And start your day on your terms. ✨

Could you go phone-free for the first 30 minutes of your day? 👇

videos.title: Her Income More Than Doubled: Here's How.
videos.description:

Before B-School, Sarah Hawkey was running around NYC piecing together voice lesson gigs, calling it a side hustle. Now she runs a real business. This is her story, in her own words.

When your income more than doubles, it's definitely worth celebrating. But the number isn't the whole story.

Behind that kind of growth is someone who decided to bet on their ideas, learn what they didn't know, and actually take action.
